items.criterion: A published case study serves its hero image from the object store.
items.judgment: The object exists in the bucket under the case prefix and streams to an anonymous caller.
items.evidence: The bucket listing under the case prefix, and the byte response from the asset route.

items.criterion: A draft record's media is unreachable to everybody without the author role.
items.judgment: The object key returns a refusal to a stranger and to a reader, and the bytes to an author.
items.evidence: Three responses from the asset route under three principals.

items.criterion: A draft record answers exactly as a slug that never existed answers.
items.judgment: Status, body length and wording agree between the draft answer and the absent answer.
items.evidence: The paired responses for the draft slug and a minted absent slug.

items.criterion: Identical bytes uploaded twice to one case leave one object and one asset row.
items.judgment: The bucket holds one object at the derived key and the asset table holds one row.
items.evidence: The bucket listing and the asset row count after the second upload.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous publishes of one case leave exactly one published row.
items.judgment: The published row count for the contested slug is one, carrying one publication time.
items.evidence: The row count and the publication time after two concurrent publish calls.

items.criterion: Signup creates a reader whatever role the payload asks for.
items.judgment: The created account row holds the reader role.
items.evidence: The account row written by a signup that asked for the author role.

items.criterion: A stored contact enquiry exists for a well-formed submission and none for a refused one.
items.judgment: The enquiry table gains one row for the good submission and none for the bad ones.
items.evidence: The enquiry row counts before and after the three submissions.

items.criterion: Every author-only mutation attempted by a reader is refused at the API.
items.judgment: Each attempt returns a refusal and the target row is unchanged afterwards.
items.evidence: The refusal statuses and the re-read rows for the create, upload and publish attempts.

items.criterion: An unknown address renders the studio's own not-found page and answers as not found.
items.judgment: The response is a not-found status and carries the studio heading, the lost line and the homepage link.
items.evidence: The response to a minted unknown address.

items.criterion: The sitemap lists published public routes alone.
items.judgment: The sitemap names the published case and omits the draft one.

items.criterion: The interface sits on a near-black ground with white reading text at a long measure.
items.judgment: A judge reading the home route sees a dark ground and white body copy at the pinned size.
items.evidence: A screenshot of the home route.

items.criterion: A display headline assembles letter by letter out of depth.
items.judgment: A judge watching the hero sees individual letters turn flat into line rather than a block fading in.
items.evidence: A recording of the hero on first load.
